name: Prefer One Another
overview: Scripture commands believers to love one another deeply and sacrificially, reflecting the love Christ has shown us (John 13:34). This love is expressed through honoring and preferring one another above ourselves (Romans 12:10), serving each other in humility and patience (Ephesians 4:2; Galatians 5:13), and extending kindness and forgiveness as God has forgiven us (Ephesians 4:32). Fulfilling this call to love is central to obeying God's law and living in true Christian liberty (Romans 13:8; Galatians 5:13).
